mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, UNIT_SERIAL, MAKER_TYPE, BIKE_SERIAL, MAKER_ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_EN_NAME, ITEM_NICK_NAME, ITEM_UNIT_SET, REAL_NAME, FILE_NAME, FILE_SIZE, FILE_TYPE, IMG_WIDTH, IMG_HEIGHT, MEMO FROM CM_BIKE_ITEM WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_BIKE_ITEM ( REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, UNIT_SERIAL, MAKER_TYPE, BIKE_SERIAL, MAKER_ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_EN_NAME, ITEM_NICK_NAME, ITEM_UNIT_SET, MEMO ) VALUES ( NOW(), #{registIp}, 'N', '00', #{useBit}, #{unitSerial}, #{makerType}, #{bikeSerial}, #{makerItemCode}, #{itemName}, #{itemEnName}, #{itemNickName}, #{itemUnitSet}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_BIKE_ITEM SET MODIFY_DATE = NOW(), MODIFY_IP = #{modifyIp}, USE_BIT = #{useBit}, UNIT_SERIAL = #{unitSerial}, MAKER_TYPE = #{makerType}, BIKE_SERIAL = #{bikeSerial}, MAKER_ITEM_CODE = #{makerItemCode}, ITEM_NAME = #{itemName}, ITEM_EN_NAME = #{itemEnName}, ITEM_NICK_NAME = #{itemNickName}, ITEM_UNIT_SET = #{itemUnitSet}, MEMO = #{memo} WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
UPDATE CM_BIKE_ITEM SET CANCEL_BIT = 'Y', CANCEL_DATE = NOW() WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
